FCP.Title: Phone Companion
FCP.Settings.MobileMode.Name: Companion mode on this device
FCP.Settings.MobileMode.Hint: Auto: enabled on phones and tablets. On: always use the companion interface on this device (useful for testing on desktop). Off: never.
FCP.Settings.KeepAwake.Name: Keep phone screens on
FCP.Settings.KeepAwake.Hint: While the companion is open the phone does not dim or lock by itself. A locked screen drops the connection and Foundry reloads the page on unlock. Uses a bit more battery.
FCP.Settings.LiveDay.Name: Live day
FCP.Settings.LiveDay.Hint: For events with new players and paper sheets: whoever has an assigned character always opens the phone on the map, to move the token; sheet, actions, items and chat stay in the bottom bar. No buttons to log out or switch to the desktop UI. Accounts and QR codes from the "Live day accesses" button.
FCP.Settings.LiveLoginUrl.Name: Direct login page (live day)
FCP.Settings.LiveLoginUrl.Hint: Optional. Address of the module's tools/live-login page, published on Foundry's own domain (e.g. /accesso/). When set, the QR code logs in directly with a random password; when empty, the QR code opens Foundry's join page and the player picks the character's name (accounts without a password).
FCP.Live.Menu.Name: Live day accesses
FCP.Live.Menu.Label: Accounts and QR codes
FCP.Live.Menu.Hint: Create an account for each pregenerated character and print the cards with the login QR code.
FCP.Live.Title: Live day accesses
FCP.Live.Off: Live day is off: players will get the full companion. Turn it on in the module settings.
FCP.Live.IntroDirect: Tick the characters in play. Each account is linked to a character, owns it and has a random password only the QR code knows. The QR code logs in directly: printing changes the passwords and older cards stop working.
FCP.Live.IntroJoin: Tick the characters in play. Each account is linked to a character, owns it and has no password. The QR code opens Foundry's join page: the player picks the name on the card and presses Join.
FCP.Live.NoCharacters: There are no player characters in this world.
FCP.Live.NoDisplay: No user without a character to use as a screen.
FCP.Live.Show: Show the QR code on the screen (new password: this character's printed card stops working)
FCP.Live.Shown: {name}'s QR code on {display}: it goes away when they log in.
FCP.Live.ShownOffline: {display} is not connected: {name}'s QR code is not showing.
FCP.Live.CardDirect: Scan the QR code with the phone camera.
FCP.Live.CardJoin: Scan the QR code with the camera, pick "{name}" and press Join. Without QR: {host}
FCP.Live.NothingToCreate: The ticked characters already have an account.
FCP.Live.NoAccounts: No ticked character has an account: create one first.
FCP.Live.NewPasswordsWarning: The ticked accounts get a new password: cards printed earlier stop working and anyone logged in with those accounts is disconnected.
FCP.Settings.CanvasPrompted.Name: Canvas prompt shown
FCP.Settings.MinimapTokens.Name: Tokens shown on the phone minimap
FCP.Settings.MinimapTokens.Hint: Which tokens players see on the companion minimap. Hidden tokens are never shown.
FCP.Settings.MoveRelay.Name: Validate moves on the GM client
FCP.Settings.MoveRelay.Hint: Movement requests from phones are executed by the connected GM client, which checks walls. If no GM is connected the phone moves the token directly.
FCP.Settings.ChatLimit.Name: Chat messages kept on the phone
FCP.Settings.ChatLimit.Hint: How many recent chat messages the companion renders.
FCP.CanvasPrompt.Title: Faster loading on the phone
FCP.CanvasPrompt.Content:
The companion does not need the game map. Disabling the canvas on this device makes Foundry load much faster and use far less memory.

You can re-enable it later from Settings → Core.
FCP.NoActor: No character assigned to your user. Ask the GM to give you ownership of a character.
FCP.NoToken: Your character has no token on the active scene.
FCP.NoGM: No GM connected: the move was applied directly, without wall checks.
FCP.MoveDenied: You do not control this token.
FCP.Picker.Title: From the compendium
FCP.Picker.Empty: Nothing to choose with this filter.
FCP.Move.Title: Move
FCP.Move.Hint: Tap an arrow to move one square, or tap a spot on the map.
FCP.Move.HintPad: Tap an arrow to move one square.
FCP.ExitCompanion: Full Foundry interface (this browser tab only)
FCP.LogOutConfirm: Log out of Foundry? You will go back to the join page.
FCP.Settings.QuickRolls.Name: Quick rolls (skip system dialogs)
FCP.Settings.QuickRolls.Hint: Roll immediately with the mode chosen on the phone (advantage, reaction…). Turn off to get the system's roll configuration dialog.
FCP.DH.ExperienceHint: Tap to add to the next roll (costs 1 Hope)
FCP.Settings.DigitalDice.Name: Digital dice
FCP.Settings.DigitalDice.Hint: Off (default, for playing at the table with real dice): the sheet is a reference, tapping an item shows its text. On: tapping abilities, attacks and spells rolls through Foundry, and the chat gets a quick dice bar.
FCP.MoveUnchecked: Moved without wall check: the GM does not have the scene open.
FCP.D5.DeathHint: Death saving throws, marked by hand.
FCP.Settings.MapFog.Name: Fog of war on the phone map
FCP.Settings.MapFog.Hint: The phone map shows background, walls and tokens only in the areas the party explored. The GM client records them as player tokens move: a GM must be connected with the scene open. Off, the map shows the whole background.
FCP.Settings.MapStyle.Name: Phone map style
FCP.Settings.MapStyle.Hint: Schematic: white ground with the scene grid and walls in black, readable on any map. Image: the scene background under the walls.
FCP.Doc.SaveFailed: The latest changes to “{name}” were not saved: check the connection.
FCP.Notes.Empty: No notes yet. Tap “Quick note” to start.
FCP.Notes.Unsupported: Open this kind of page on the laptop.
FCP.Vfx.NoToken: No token on the scene: place your character on the map.
FCP.Vfx.Fail.noGM: No GM connected: effects play on the GM's screen.
FCP.Vfx.Fail.missing: Effect not played: token or item not found.
FCP.Vfx.Fail.denied: You do not control this character.
FCP.Vfx.Fail.scene: The GM does not have your token's scene open.
FCP.Vfx.Fail.error: Error while playing the effect (see the GM's console).
FCP.Vfx.Fail.noTargets: No effect without targets: pick a target in the strip first.
FCP.Vfx.Fail.timeout: The GM did not answer: a GM needs to be connected with your token's scene open.
FCP.Spells.NoCaster: This character has no spellcasting class.
FCP.Spells.Help: Tap a spell to prepare it, tap again to remove it.
FCP.Spells.HelpBook: Tap a spell to copy it into your spellbook, then again to prepare it.
FCP.Spells.FullCantrips: You already know {max} cantrips: remove one to pick another.
FCP.Spells.FullPrepared: You already have {max} prepared spells: remove one to prepare another.
FCP.Spells.LoadError: Could not read the class spell list.
FCP.Spells.ApplyError: The spell changes could not be saved.
FCP.Spells.NoneMine: None yet: pick from the list below.
FCP.MoveNoAnswer: The GM did not answer: the token stayed where it was. Try again in a moment.
FCP.MoveStuck: The move did not finish: the d-pad is active again, check the position on the map.
FCP.GmOffScene: {name} is moving on “{scene}”, but you are viewing another scene: walls and fog are not checked.
FCP.HpNotApplied: Damage not applied (the armor choice was closed or not answered). The number is still there: try again.
FCP.Live.ShowNewPassword: The QR on the display uses a new password: the printed card of {name} will stop working. Continue?
